question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/159bd3def078ae85ab13b12ad8c03182c1357245886eef68a38664c3572d5ff7.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step 1: Square and arrow rotating 90º clockwise direction.

Step 2: Left element also rotating 90º clockwise direction with new element in each next step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/172213a267b7ab5ca5105cb3f6ad89941c1136c6d98eda6ad3520706eadf1a22.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2"**
